   9  def want_bytes(
  10      s: str | bytes, encoding: str = "utf-8", errors: str = "strict"
  11  ) -> bytes:
  12      if isinstance(s, str):
  13          s = s.encode(encoding, errors)
  14

  18  def base64_encode(string: str | bytes) -> bytes:
  19      """Base64 encode a string of bytes or text. The resulting bytes are
  20      safe to use in URLs.
  21      """
  22      string = want_bytes(string)
  23      return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(string).rstrip(b"=")

  26  def base64_decode(string: str | bytes) -> bytes:
  27      """Base64 decode a URL-safe string of bytes or text. The result is
  28      bytes.
  29      """
  30      string = want_bytes(string, encoding="ascii", errors="ignore")
  31      string += b"=" * (-len(string) % 4)
